note: Pictures and posts from the voyage, added by hand. Instagram closed the door on reading a public account automatically - the Basic Display API was withdrawn in December 2024, and what replaced it needs the account owner's own token, which we do not have and should not ask for. So this file is the honest version: paste a link, give it a date and a line of text, and it appears in the ship's log, newest first, alongside the arrivals and departures. Anything with a public URL works, not only Instagram. Only https links are rendered.
